label: possible heart attack
advice: sit down, stop all activity, and call an ambulance. Chew an aspirin only if a doctor has already told you it is safe for you.

label: possible stroke
advice: note the exact time the symptoms started - it changes the treatment. Do not give food or water.

label: severe breathing difficulty
advice: sit upright, loosen tight clothing, and get emergency help now.

label: severe bleeding
advice: press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth and keep pressing. Do not pull out an object stuck in a wound.

label: thoughts of self-harm
advice: they are not alone. Encourage them to talk to someone they trust right now and to call a crisis line. In India, Tele-MANAS is 14416.

label: poisoning or overdose
advice: do not make yourself vomit. Keep the packet or bottle and show it to the doctor.

label: possible serious infection
advice: do not wait to see if it improves overnight - this needs a doctor today.

label: severe allergic reaction
words: swelling of the face with breathing
advice: this can close the airway within minutes. Use an adrenaline auto-injector if they have one and call an ambulance.

label: pregnancy emergency
advice: go to the nearest hospital with maternity care now.

label: seizure or loss of consciousness
advice: lie them on their side, clear the space around them, put nothing in the mouth, and time how long it lasts.
